pluss::timeindex::from_buffer¶

Back to TimeIndex Factory API Reference

Signature¶

pluss::TimeIndex pluss::timeindex::from_buffer(
    std::int64_t* data,
    std::int64_t size,
    std::int64_t stride = 1,
    pluss::BlobDeleter deleter = {},
    std::string_view tz_name = "UTC",
    bool require_sorted = true)

Adopt External Epoch-Nanosecond Storage¶

from_buffer() is the explicit systems boundary for storage allocated outside TimeIndex. Each logical lane is one signed 64-bit epoch-nanosecond tick at data[i * stride]. The factory validates index invariants, records timezone presentation metadata, and arranges for deleter to run exactly once when the adopted source storage is no longer needed.

Use this path for foreign runtimes, memory-mapped regions, custom allocators, or producer libraries that already own tick storage. Use make() for ordinary vectors and literals; it has fewer lifetime obligations.

Parameters And Invariants¶

Parameter

Meaning

Default

data

Address of the first signed 64-bit epoch-nanosecond value

required

size

Number of logical timestamps

required

stride

Distance between logical values, measured in int64_t elements

1

deleter

Callback receiving the original allocation address

empty

tz_name

Timezone used to present the stored instants

"UTC"

require_sorted

Require non-decreasing ticks

true

size must be non-negative and stride positive. Every logical tick must be defined; the reserved NaT value is rejected. Timezone metadata never rewrites ticks. With ordering enforcement disabled, the resulting axis may be inspected or sorted, but ordered lookup and window operations remain inappropriate until it is increasing.

Sharing Versus Materialization¶

A packed buffer (stride == 1) is adopted without copying. Mutations through the original pointer remain visible while that pointer is valid, and the deleter runs after the final shared owner releases the storage.

A strided buffer is different. TimeIndex kernels require packed ticks, so the factory copies logical lanes once during construction. The original strided allocation can then be released immediately through its deleter; subsequent TimeIndex values own the packed materialization. This distinction prevents every search and rolling kernel from paying stride-aware access costs.

Examples¶

Example 1. A packed buffer is shared and its callback is deferred.

bool freed = false;
{
  auto* raw = static_cast<std::int64_t*>(
      std::malloc(3 * sizeof(std::int64_t)));
  raw[0] = 0;
  raw[1] = 1'000'000'000LL;
  raw[2] = 2'000'000'000LL;

  auto index = pluss::timeindex::from_buffer(
      raw, 3, 1,
      [&](void* pointer) { freed = true; std::free(pointer); });
  raw[1] = 1'500'000'000LL;

  const auto ticks = index.host();
  std::cout << "ticks=[" << ticks[0] << ", " << ticks[1]
            << ", " << ticks[2] << "]\n";
  std::cout << std::boolalpha << "freed_inside=" << freed << "\n";
}
std::cout << std::boolalpha << "freed_after=" << freed << "\n";

Output¶

ticks=[0, 1500000000, 2000000000]
freed_inside=false
freed_after=true

Example 2. A stride of two selects alternating storage lanes and materializes them immediately.

bool freed = false;
auto* raw = static_cast<std::int64_t*>(
    std::malloc(6 * sizeof(std::int64_t)));
raw[0] = 0;               raw[1] = -1;
raw[2] = 1'000'000'000LL; raw[3] = -1;
raw[4] = 2'000'000'000LL; raw[5] = -1;

auto index = pluss::timeindex::from_buffer(
    raw, 3, 2,
    [&](void* pointer) { freed = true; std::free(pointer); });
const auto ticks = index.host();
std::cout << "ticks=[" << ticks[0] << ", " << ticks[1]
          << ", " << ticks[2] << "]\n";
std::cout << std::boolalpha << "source_freed=" << freed << "\n";

Output¶

ticks=[0, 1000000000, 2000000000]
source_freed=true

Example 3. Timezone metadata controls presentation without changing the raw tick.

auto* raw = static_cast<std::int64_t*>(std::malloc(sizeof(std::int64_t)));
raw[0] = 1'735'748'400'000'000'000LL;
auto local = pluss::timeindex::from_buffer(
    raw, 1, 1, [](void* pointer) { std::free(pointer); },
    "America/Edmonton");
std::cout << pluss::timeindex::print(local) << "\n";

Output¶

TimeIndex(shape=[1], tz=America/Edmonton)
[ 2025-01-01 09:20:00 ]

Example 4. Invalid stride is rejected before ownership is adopted.

std::int64_t value = 0;
try {
  (void)pluss::timeindex::from_buffer(&value, 1, 0);
} catch (const std::exception& error) {
  std::cout << std::string_view(error.what()).substr(0,
      std::string_view(error.what()).find('\n')) << "\n";
}

Output¶

timeindex::from_buffer: stride must be positive

Safety And Cost¶

The caller must supply storage large enough for every addressed lane and must not free it independently after successful adoption. The deleter must match the allocator and must not throw. Packed construction is O(n) validation without a data copy; strided construction performs O(n) validation plus one O(n) packed copy.
